note: Unscored personalisation and interactivity layer, applied by tools/personalise.py at build time. Proposed wording — SME confirms.

screen.title: Check: after the fire
screen.prompt_html: Quick check (not scored). The fire is out, so staff can go back to their rooms.

feedback.correct_html: Right — it's false. Stand down only when the Incident Commander gives the End of Disaster announcement.
feedback.incorrect_html: Not yet. A fire being out is not the signal. Wait for the End of Disaster announcement from the Incident Commander.

hs1-410.title: Your part in a Code Red
hs1-410.lead: What you do first depends on where you work.

items.title: Rescue
items.body_html: Move patients in your area away from smoke first: the ones who can walk, then those who need help. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Evacuation tools
items.body_html: Use the evacuation chair or sheet as you were trained; never the lift.

items.title: Stop arrivals
items.body_html: Stop new patients and visitors entering the affected area and guide those waiting to the assembly point. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Count heads
items.body_html: Keep the day's appointment list at hand so the team can check no one is left inside.

items.title: Clear the route
items.body_html: Keep corridors and fire doors clear; never block a door open. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Isolate as directed
items.body_html: Facilities isolate gas, oxygen or power only when the Incident Commander asks.

screen.title: Check: the unlabelled bottle
screen.prompt_html: Quick check (not scored). A courier hands you a bottle with no label and says it is the new disinfectant. What do you do?

feedback.incorrect_html: Never accept an unlabelled container: refuse it and route it through procurement.

options.text_html: Accept it and add a label yourself
options.feedback_html: A label you write is a guess. Without the supplier label and SDS, nobody knows the hazard.

options.text_html: Refuse it and send it back through procurement
options.feedback_html: Right: approved procurement only, on the inventory, with its SDS.

options.text_html: Put it in the store room until someone asks
options.feedback_html: An unknown chemical in storage is a hazard for the next person.

screen.title: Put it where it belongs
screen.prompt_html: Practice (not scored). Drag each item to where it is stored or thrown away.

feedback.correct_html: All in the right place. Flammables live in the approved cabinet, anything sharp goes in the sharps container, and anything soiled with body fluids is infectious waste.
feedback.incorrect_html: Not yet. Sharp items always go in the sharps container; anything with blood or body fluids is infectious waste. Bin colours follow your facility poster. ⚠ Draft — pending 01/B7.

append_html.hs1-990: As a {{role_label}}: start with the first item on this list in your own area this week.

hs1-410.title: Fire prevention: what not to bring
hs1-410.prompt_html: Find all seven things that should not be in this staff room.
hs1-410.image_alt: Staff room with seven fire hazards: a candle, a home extension lead, a fan heater, a vape, a microwave, an open flammable bottle and welding kit by the door.

regions.feedback_html: Open flame is banned everywhere in the clinic.
Personal heaters and electric boilers are not allowed.
Only approved kitchen appliances, in approved places.
Flammables stay closed, labelled and in the approved cabinet.
Hot work only with a Facilities permit.

hs1-410.brief: Flat staff-room scene, 16:9: a small table and chairs, a kitchen counter. Seven separate, clearly visible items: a lit candle, a cheap home extension lead with several plugs, a small fan heater, a vape on the table, a microwave on the counter, an open bottle with a flame pictogram shape (no text), a welding kit propped by the door. Each item at least 48 px at 960×540, not overlapping.

feedback.correct_html: All seven found. Flame and fuel, unsafe electrics and blocked exits start most clinic fires. If you see one at work, remove it or report it.
feedback.incorrect_html: Keep looking: there are seven things in this room that should not be there.
